- Na₂CO₃ = 105.988 g/mol
- MgCO₃ = 84.313 g/mol
- MgO = 40.304 g/mol

Residue from NaHCO₃:
\[
\frac{105.988}{2(84.006)}x = 0.6308359x
\]

Residue from MgCO₃:
\[
\frac{40.304}{84.313}(15.00-x) = 0.4780283(15.00-x)
\]

Total residue:
\[
0.6308359x + 0.4780283(15.00-x) = 8.80
\]

Solving:
\[
0.1528076x = 1.6295755
\]
\[
x = 10.6642 \text{ g}
\]

Mass percentage of NaHCO₃:
\[
